entry_point.cli: README.md:115 ('The examples below use bash scripts with the Hydra CLI') and :134 -> examples/scripts/seq_des.sh:5-9: python3 caliby/eval/sampling/seq_des.py ckpt_name_or_path=soluble_caliby_v1 input_cfg.pdb_dir=<dir> sampling_cfg_overrides.num_seqs_per_pdb=4 out_dir=<dir> (Hydra configs/eval/sampling/seq_des.yaml: seed 0 [:2], batch_size 4, num_workers 2; seq_des.py:22-24 seed_everything + cudnn.deterministic=True, benchmark=False); ensemble: examples/scripts/generate_ensembles.sh:5-9 (generate_ensembles.py model_params_path=model_params input_cfg.pdb_dir=<dir> num_samples_per_pdb=8 out_dir=<dir>) then seq_des_ensemble.sh:8-12 (seq_des_ensemble.py ckpt_name_or_path=caliby input_cfg.conformer_dir=<generator out>/<protocol dir> sampling_cfg_overrides.num_seqs_per_pdb=4 out_dir=<dir>). examples/ is not in the vendored archive (archive_recipe); the kit drives the Python API (below), whose keywords `run.sh design` forwards under upstream's names
entry_point.defaults: three upstream defaults disagree: the README script designs 4 sequences with soluble_caliby_v1 (examples/scripts/seq_des.sh:6-8); the YAML 16 with caliby (configs/eval/sampling/seq_des.yaml:6,26); the API 1 with caliby (caliby/api.py:359 model_name, :100 num_seqs_per_pdb); the kit's route is the API's: a knob not given on `run.sh design` is not passed, so caliby/api.py's defaults apply (1 sequence, model_name caliby, batch 4, 2 workers, temperature 0.01, verbose, no constraints; generate_ensembles 32 conformers in batches of 8)
entry_point.api: caliby.clean_pdbs(inputs, out_dir, num_workers=1) [caliby/api.py:401-405] -> caliby.load_model(model_name='caliby', device=None) [caliby/api.py:358-362] -> constraints (caliby.make_constraints / a positional-constraint DataFrame, or None) -> lightning.seed_everything(seed) -> model.sample(inputs, out_dir, pos_constraint_df=None, num_seqs_per_pdb=1, batch_size=4, num_workers=2, temperature=0.01, omit_aas=None, ...) [caliby/api.py:81-112]; ensemble: caliby.generate_ensembles(...) then model.ensemble_sample(...) (python_api.md §Ensemble-conditioned sequence design)
entry_point.order_note: the call order above (clean -> load_model -> constraints -> seed -> sample) is the order of opt/forward/xattempt_addon/tests/xcaliby_design.py (main), the tree's design writer
entry_point.script: opt/caliby_opt/stock_design.py (the tree's one stock caller: environment proof + tree-digest proof, then the design writer above in the same process)
entry_point.quickstart: python_api.md §Quick start: model = load_model("caliby"); model.sample(["examples/example_data/native_pdbs/7xhz.cif"], num_seqs_per_pdb=4, out_dir="outputs/seq_des")

library_defaults.precision: PyTorch defaults (matmul TF32 off, float32_matmul_precision highest, cudnn TF32 on); the sampler is float32

tree_digest_upstream.tool: caliby_opt.stack.tree_digest (a sha256 over the installed caliby/, chroma/ and protpardelle/ site-packages trees: per tree, sorted relative path + sha256 of every file, __pycache__ and .pyc excluded; then the three tree digests in name order)
